name: twitter

dimensions.name: calibrated_match
dimensions.description: Compare this tweet to the resolved examples shown in the context. The examples include tweets that HIT (reached 2x median) and tweets that MISSED. Which group does this tweet resemble more? Consider: content type, specificity, hook strength, structure, and topic. Score 8-10 if it strongly resembles the hits, 4-6 if it is ambiguous, 0-3 if it resembles the misses.

probability_guide: If calibrated_match is below 4 (resembles misses): output 0.05-0.15.
extra_considerations: The resolved examples in the context are your training data. Learn from them.
What do the hits have in common that the misses do not?
Does this tweet have those qualities?
Author history and ecosystem context are also shown for reference.
